title.romaji: Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru!
title.english: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!

synonyms: สภานักเรียนฉบับรั่ว!
description:
This is Fujinasu Academy, a private high school with top-achieving students located on the outskirts of town.

High School 1st-Year Ume Mizunoe has excellent grades in Japanese language class and has received multiple literary awards. However, his terrible grades in the sciences are affecting his ability to move up a grade. To avoid repeating a year, he becomes a member of the student council to improve his academic standing.

However, in the student council, he meets the charismatic yet sullen student council president Kotobuki Hisako, and the scary yet kind and refined treasurer, Arisu Terui. Other members include a cheeky and cute boy, Tan Otori, and Komaro Michinoku, the admin who's like a small abandoned cat. This is the start of a slapstick, heartful, rom-com about a busy student council full of cute, mismatched, and quirky students!

(Source: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! Official Site)

node.description:
__Height:__ 131 cm

She is a girl packed with distinctive traits: sleepy-looking eyes with dark circles, voluminous long hair, and a rough, raspy natural voice. She serves as the student council's mascot-like figure.

She gives her all in everything she does, but she is clumsy, prone to frequent mishaps, and cursed with an extraordinary streak of bad luck; consequently, the student council treats her as someone who needs constant looking after. Although she frequently gets into accidents, she boasts such toughness that she might simply slap a bandage on herself after being hit by a car and call it a day. She is like an endangered species—a creature with absolutely no wariness toward others.

She is a classmate of [Ume Mizunoe](https://anilist.co/character/341616/Ume-Mizunoe), though they hadn't met previously because she had been absent due to an accident. She has taken a strong liking to Ume and sticks to him constantly; her small size allows her to sit on Ume's lap without issue. Those around her say she lacks caution, likening her to a kakapo.

~!Her parents passed away in a plane crash (quite some time ago, by her account), and she now lives with her homeroom teacher, [Satomi Hiratsuka](https://anilist.co/character/341617/Satomi-Hiratsuka). Both parents were scholars; her mother was a biologist, and her father was a mathematician.!~

She is a scholarship student for mathematics, so her tuition is waived, and she reportedly earns her own spending money working part-time at a convenience store. She is highly trusted at her workplace, likely because she is a diligent worker. She generally has little desire for money; she once even caught an insect that could have been sold for a profit, but chose to keep it as a pet instead.

A third-year student at Fujinari Academy Junior High. He serves as the public relations officer for the student council.

Despite being a junior high student, he possesses enough academic ability to tutor high school students in math and science subjects. He is also highly competent in his role in public relations.

He is incredibly cute and fully aware of it; his words and personality are blatantly "cutesy" and calculated to charm, yet he is a boy. As a "cross-dressing boy" (otokonoko), his nipples are usually visible, though there are times when they are not shown.

~!His father was absent from the time he was old enough to understand his surroundings, and his mother rarely returns home, so he effectively lives alone. Perhaps due to this family situation, he tends to act affectionately toward the student council members as if they were his own family—a tendency particularly evident with [Ume](https://anilist.co/character/341616/Ume-Mizunoe) (another boy) and [Arisu](https://anilist.co/character/341618/Arisu-Terui), whom he has known for a long time.!~

A brilliant student serving as the high school division's student council president. She ranks first overall academically, with English being her strongest subject.

An outstanding individual who excels in both academics and athletics and is highly respected by others, she is frequently teased by those around her—especially [Arisu Terui](https://anilist.co/character/341618/Arisu-Terui)—due to a clumsy, scatterbrained streak stemming from her status as a closet pervert.

The other cast members are so eccentric that she ends up appearing relatively ordinary and understated by comparison. While she technically holds the "heroine" position, in reality, she often plays the victim, constantly pushed around by the oddballs surrounding her—a role that makes her quite a pitiable character.

Her sensible and reserved nature only adds to this sense of misfortune; she harbors a secret crush on the protagonist, [Ume Mizunoe](https://anilist.co/character/341616/Ume-Mizunoe), but tends to step back whenever the other girls—with their overpowering personalities—interact with him, leaving her feelings unrequited.

She holds a familial affection for the other student council members, though her feelings—including those for Ume—can sometimes be so intense that they leave her emotionally flustered.

She inherited her personality from her father, while her tendency to jump to extreme conclusions comes from her mother. She has a younger brother and a younger sister.

alternative: Psycho Manaita Youkai (サイコまな板妖怪)

node.description:
She is a second-year student in Class 4 at Fujinari Academy High School and serves as the treasurer for the student council. Her strongest subjects are biology and chemistry; she has even won awards in competitions. Although she also heads the Chemistry Club, she is effectively the only active member, as the only other person on the roster—Takaka—merely lends her name to the club.

Raised in a wealthy, refined family, she appears at first glance to be a gentle, traditional beauty—the sort raised in the lap of luxury—but she is also skilled in martial arts. She excels in both academics and athletics, making her arguably the most formidable character in the story.

She is feared throughout the school for her aggressive nature—she wouldn't hesitate to deliver a kick to the groin right off the bat—and her sharp, unsparing tongue; her presence on stage at a school assembly is enough to silence all chatter instantly.

She ruthlessly slashes club budgets for the coming term, yet because she always conducts thorough research beforehand, no one dares to challenge her decisions. Students fear her, calling her the "Psycho Flat-Chested Youkai." She treats even the faculty without mercy if issues arise, effectively making her the school's "final boss."

She maintains what she believes to be a good relationship with her cute junior, [Ume Mizunoe](https://anilist.co/character/341616/Ume-Mizunoe); however, Ume’s first impression of her was that she was a "scary person." In fact, whenever Ume encounters a suspicious incident on campus, he instinctively lists Terui-senpai as a potential person of interest.
Homeroom Teacher, High School Division Year 1, Class 2 / Head of Year. She likes Eel.

First-year student in Class 2 of the Fujinari Academy High School division. Student council secretary. Member of the Handicrafts Club.

An academic standout with exceptional grades in liberal arts subjects and a track record of winning literary awards.

Conversely, his performance in science and math subjects is abysmal—even recording single-digit test scores—putting him at risk of failing to advance to the next grade. As a result, his homeroom teacher, [Satomi Hiratsuka](https://anilist.co/character/341617/Satomi-Hiratsuka) (Biology), warned him that his grades would negatively impact his academic record and suggested he join the student council.

He acts as the "straight man" (tsukkomi) of the group; he is the voice of reason who calmly resolves comedic situations that would otherwise spiral out of control—situations that the [President](https://anilist.co/character/341619/Hisako-Kotobuki) would simply let slide or that [Arisu](https://anilist.co/character/341618/Arisu-Terui) would resolve with physical force.

Thanks to his helpful nature and pleasant personality, he becomes well-liked by people both within and outside the student council.

He tends to reveal a "troublesome otaku" side of himself when the topic turns to literature, though such moments became less frequent as he was swept along by the eccentric personalities around him.

A second-year student at the private Fujinari Academy and the president of the Handicrafts Club. 

He has a very timid personality, frequently apologizing and bursting into tears. He is also easily swayed; when the Robotics Club approached him about the clubroom issue, he promptly signed the petition without hesitation.

His crafting skills are top-notch, and he often creates incredible plush toys—such as the "Kina-Usagi" he was holding upon his first appearance, or the various plushies of turtles and mysterious creatures surrounding him. Incidentally, a teddy bear he once crafted ended up being modified into a robot by the Robotics Club. He also reportedly feels very at ease when wearing his rabbit-themed outfit.
